reports.title: Porch Group Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

lines: In Q3, we rapidly grew Reciprocal Policies Written¹ 42% year-over-year, more than doubled Adjusted EBITDA (Excluding Reciprocal)² versus the prior-year period, generated strong Adjusted EBITDA (Excluding Reciprocal)² conversion to cash for Porch shareholders, further improved our leverage ratio to the low end of our targeted range, and raised our full-year outlook again.
